room_description.en: A long, dimly lit corridor with deep red carpets and ornate gold-framed paintings. Large windows look out into a stormy night. This hallway connects the dining area to the hotel's more private wings.
room_description.zh: 一条长长的、昏暗的走廊，铺着深红色的地毯，挂着装饰华丽的金色画框。大窗户望向风暴交加的夜晚。这条走廊将用餐区与酒店更私密的侧翼连接起来。

story_fragment.en: The portraits on the wall seem to follow your every move. One frame is empty, leaving a rectangular patch of unfaded wallpaper behind.
story_fragment.zh: 墙上的肖像似乎在跟随你的一举一动。一个画框是空的，在没褪色的壁纸上留下了一个矩形的痕迹。

final_action.en: You move deeper into the hotel...
